name: ML Engineer - HealthTech
jd_text:
Machine Learning Engineer — MedAI Health

About Us:
MedAI builds AI-powered diagnostic tools for healthcare.

Requirements:
- Strong Python skills with focus on ML frameworks (TensorFlow/PyTorch)
- Experience with deep learning (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers)
- Proficiency in data preprocessing and feature engineering
- Experience with model evaluation metrics and cross-validation
- Familiarity with MLOps tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases)
- Strong mathematical foundation (linear algebra, probability, statistics)

Nice to Have:
- Experience with medical imaging datasets (DICOM)
- Knowledge of HIPAA compliance
- Experience with cloud ML services (SageMaker, Vertex AI)
- Published research in ML/AI

Responsibilities:
- Develop and deploy ML models for medical image analysis
- Design experiments and evaluate model performance
- Collaborate with clinicians to understand requirements
- Maintain ML pipelines and model versioning
